name: HackerOne
description: Scope is machine-readable over a public GraphQL endpoint; a program is claimed by its handle.

policy_fetch.notes: Public program lookup by handle. No login: the response is the platform's own structured scope, so it is the highest-confidence scope source available.

scope_extraction.notes: structured_scopes: eligible_for_submission decides in/out; a path-restricted asset is recorded but never widened to a host rule.

mandatory_conditions.text: Reports must be sent from the researcher's @wearehackerone.com address; a report from another address is rejected by the platform before it reaches the program.
Disclosure timing is governed by the program's policy and the platform, not by the hunter.
